Preserve the existing 'leader absent while members remain' fail-closed branch unchanged. Add a pid-reuse fixture (leader startedAt changed, rows still present) proving no signal is sent, the outcome is vanished evidence rather than residual, and a real remaining-descendant match still yields needs_human. Do not touch src/agents/worker-lease.ts recovery path and do not weaken any exact-identity comparison.
nonGoals: Do not signal an identity-reused group.
Do not change compareProcessIdentity or weaken the exact-identity guard.
Do not change the worker-lease recovery path.
Do not use broad or name-based kills.
deliverables: Vanished/reused classification with evidence instead of residual failure.
A pid-reuse fixture and remaining-descendant needs_human test.
